title: NC-PLUS-FN-1: Seed funding options into D1 and expose GET /api/programs for readback
body:
**Owner:** funding-manager
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-FN-1 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-FN-1
**Status:** closed

Seed funding options into D1 and expose GET /api/programs for readback

Backlog done check: Options saved in git (seed script committed) and GET /api/programs returns the seeded rows from D1

Triage: Requires committing a seed script and implementing a GET /api/programs endpoint; the in-Worker doer can write D1 but cannot edit code or commit to git. | first step: Dispatch a coding agent to add a committed seed script writing funding options to D1 and implement GET /api/programs to read rows back.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
